main_text.p: חָרְשִׁין, Syr. ܚܪܫܝܢ, emph. ܚܪܫܝܢ. Fœm. ܚܪܫܝܢ, Marc.9.25.
חֲרְשָׁא, חוּרְשָׁא Ch.Sylva. Plur. חוּרְשַׁיָּא, חוּרְשִׁין.
חרת Ch. Sculpere, exsculpere, exarare, incidere.
Partic.Pehil חֲרִית Exsculptum, Incisum. Plur. חֲרִיתִין.

חִישָׁה Ch.Silentium, לְחִישַׁת חוּרְשָׁא In silentia sylvæ, per hypallagen, pro in sylvam silentem, Hebr. לְבָמוֹת יָעַר In excelsa sylvæ. Baal Aruch exponit מָקוֹם קָנִים locu arundinum, Arundinetū. Jerem.26.18. Mich.3.ult.
חֲשָׁאִי, חֲשָׁי Ch. Silentium, sufurratio, tacitum, secretū: בְּחֲשָׁאִי In silentio, silenter, clam, tacitè.

חָשַׁב Ch.& Syr. Cogitare, excogitare, putare, imputare, computare, reputare, supputare, æstimare, existimare. Pahel חַשֵּׁב Idem. Aphel אַחְשִׁיב Idem. Ithpahel אִתְחַשַּׁב Cogitare: Item Putari, imputari, reputari. Ithpeh. אִתְחַשַּׁב Idem.
חַשְׁבָּא Ch. Cogitator, æstimator, supputator. Plural. emph. חַשְׁבַיָּא Jesa.33.18.
חוּשְׁבְּנָא, חוּשְׁבָּן Ch.& Syr. Ratio, computatio, supputatio. Plur. constr. חוּשְׁבְּנֵי עָבוּרִין Supputationes embolismorum, Cantic.7.5.
חִשְׁבּוֹן Ch. Idem, Eccl.7.28. Plur. חִשְׁבּוֹנִין Ibid.v.ult.
ܚܫܒܘܢ Syr. Idem. Plur. ܚܫܒܘܢܝ Ex cogitationibus animæ: Alii legunt, ܚܫܒܘܢ Ex tenebris,Jac.3.15.

page.notes: Syriac and Hebrew forms are reproduced approximately; several Syriac words in the scan are hard to read and may be imperfect. The word at the lower right is a Hebrew catchword-like line and is transcribed as printed.
